info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Rideshare Rides Status-v3-spec
info.description: The Rideshare Ride Status API allows users to retrieve the current status of rideshare rides. This endpoint provides information regarding various ride statuses, enabling consumers like rideshare applications and tracking services to efficiently manage and display ride updates. By leveraging this API, developers can enhance user experiences with real-time data, ensuring that riders and drivers are informed about their ride progress. Typical use cases include displaying ride readiness and tracking delays in rideshare platforms.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of a specific ride.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to obtain the current status of a ride by providing the necessary identification. It returns information on the ride's progress, estimated time of arrival, and any other relevant updates.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the status of rides. It should adhere to the schema defined for ride status operations, ensuring all necessary information is provided in the specified format.

206.description: Partial content returned, indicating that the request was successful but the response contains only a subset of the requested data.

ListRideshareRidesStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for getting the ride status. It contains a string value that specifies the request details.

processingTimeMs.description: The time in milliseconds that the server took to process the request.
